MimicReplayProtocol
Replays a MIMIC-III Waveform Database record into the FRAMED EventBus in (scaled) real time, exercising the normal, non-interop data path: each decoded sample is published as a parsed DataPoint message on an address of the shape "<className>.<deviceID>.<channelID>.parsed", exactly as the live device drivers do.
MimicReplayProtocol.PacingStats
Immutable summary of how closely replay followed its schedule.
MllpClient

MllpServer
MLLP server (the message responder): listens for connections, reads each framed HL7 message and replies with the acknowledgement produced by the supplied handler.

TrendClassificationReactor
A specialized Reactor that detects a decreasing trend (downward drift) in numeric channel values using a sliding window and a slope-based metric.
TrendDirection
Enumerates the directions of trends: TrendDirection.UP: find upwards trends TrendDirection.DOWN: find downwards trends TrendDirection.BOTH: find both up- and downwards trends
TrendMode
Enumerates the mode of tends conditions supported: TrendMode.MEAN_STEP_DIFF: The trend is measured by the mean difference between observed data points. TrendMode.REGRESSION_SLOPE: The trend is measured by the best fitting slope (regression).
UDPTransport
A Transport implementation using UDP datagrams for lightweight, connectionless messaging.
WfdbHeader
A parsed WFDB header (.hea) file, covering the three header flavours used by the MIMIC-III Waveform Database: Master (multi-segment) header — its record line carries a /numSegments suffix and it lists one WfdbHeader.Segment per line instead of signal specifications.
WfdbHeader.Segment
A segment reference on a master (multi-segment) header line.
WfdbSegmentReader
Decodes the raw ADC samples of a single WFDB segment from its .dat file.
WfdbSignal
The specification of a single signal, as declared on one signal-specification line of a WFDB header file.
